title: Three Weeks and One Short Needle
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：suit　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 suit 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the tailor ① wore the suit that no customer in the shop would have counted, and he said the wearing was the whole of the week. The ② suit, meaning the outfit itself and not the needle, ran three weeks and stayed uncounted in the book; a suit, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ suit in that shop had the same short needle beside it, and the ④ suit at the far mirror, meaning the collar they kept for the children to mend and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A suit, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the tailor said the counting is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the suit was the whole of the matter, meaning the dignity and not the outfit. The ⑥ suit, meaning the dignity and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; suit, he said, is either something you wear or the only word that means both an outfit and a dignity. He said the dignity is the part they remember.

By 1994 the ⑦ suit had become a line in an order, and the order had become an argument about the short needle. The ⑧ suit of the whole thing, the tailor wrote in November, was one shop and three weeks of counting; suit, he said, is either the collar at the far mirror or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ suit I remember is the outfit counted in the order, which closed in 1996 and is still counted as the quietest in the shop. A ⑩ suit, my mother said in 1998, is the only outfit that improves by being counted; every suit, she said, is a dignity that has agreed to look like an outfit. She said the dignity was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 套装；西装（指裁缝铺里每一套旁边的那一套）
B. n. 套装；西装（指那套套装本身，与细细的针相对）
C. 固定搭配：wear the suit 穿这一套套装
D. n. 套装；西装（指留给孩子们补的那一道）
E. n. 套装之事（抽象总称，指一处裁缝铺的套装之事）
F. n. 套装；西装（指订单簿里写到、被清点的那一套）
G. n. 套装、体面（指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 体面（抽象总称，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: wore the suit that no customer in the shop would have counted
The suit, meaning the outfit itself and not the needle
the suit at the far mirror
the suit was the whole of the matter
the suit had become a line in an order
The suit of the whole thing
A suit, my mother said in 1998

answers.why: wear the suit 意为“穿这一套套装”，1989 年那位裁缝把裁缝铺里没有一位顾客肯清点的一套套装做了一遍。
suit 意为“套装；西装”，指那套套装本身而不是细细的针，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被清点。
suit 意为“套装；西装”，指裁缝铺里每一套旁边的那一套，每一套旁边都有同一枚细细的针。
suit 意为“套装；西装”，指最远那面试衣镜的留给孩子们补的那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
suit 意为“套装、体面”，指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这套体面就是那件事的全部。
suit 意为“体面”，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西而不是那套套装，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
suit 意为“套装；西装”，指订单簿里写到、被清点的那一套，到 1994 年这一套成了订单簿里的一行。
suit 意为“套装之事”，裁缝十一月写道，整件事的套装之事是一处裁缝铺和三个星期的清点。
suit 意为“套装；西装”，我记得的是订单簿里清点过的那一套，1996 年缝好了，至今仍被说成裁缝铺里最安静的一套。
suit 为抽象总称，母亲 1998 年说，套装是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的套装。
